name: generated::polaris::v1 and FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET

test_list.description: The embedded FileDescriptorSet defines PolarisKernelService, WorkerService and GuestService with exactly the RPCs of the plan, with the streaming flags the plan lists.
GuestHandshakeResponse still has protocol_version, guest_version, os, arch and pid (the fields spike S0-12 printed) at stable numbers.
A table of (message, field, number) for the envelope messages (Event kinds, CommandBody kinds, EventRecord, Command, handshakes) matches the descriptor: renumbering fails the test.
Every message with a oneof or evolving payload reserves 100..=199, and no field uses a reserved number.
Every enum has value 0 named *_UNSPECIFIED, so a default message can never decode to a real variant.
No Event or CommandBody payload field is of type bytes; they are Cid messages (only token and stream chunk frames carry inline bytes).
Synthetic golden encodings of a Cid, a Uuid and a SessionClosed event record match literal hex (wire compatibility).
The tonic client and server modules of the three services are usable types (compile-time reference).

inputs.name: proto files
inputs.description: common.proto, kernel.proto, worker.proto, guest.proto compiled by build.rs with the vendored protoc.

output_description: Message types, tonic clients/servers and the descriptor set, isolated under generated::polaris::v1.
